FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN VITE_API_URL=/api pnpm run build
RUN npm --prefix server ci
RUN cd server && npx prisma generate
# Retain the application's settings and category initialization, but exclude all demo accounts.
RUN node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; const seed=fs.readFileSync("server/prisma/seed.ts","utf8"); const prefix=seed.slice(0,seed.indexOf("  const adminHash")); fs.writeFileSync("server/bootstrap.ts",prefix + "\n  if (!process.env.JWT_SECRET || !process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD) throw new Error(\"Required environment missing\");\n  await prisma.admin.upsert({where:{username:\"sindiswa-cell\"},update:{},create:{username:\"sindiswa-cell\",fullName:\"System Administrator\",email:\"sindiswa-cell@localhost.invalid\",passwordHash:await bcrypt.hash(process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD,12),active:true,mustChangePassword:false}});\n}\nawait main();\nawait prisma.$disconnect();\nawait import(\"./src/index.ts\");\nawait import(\"./gateway.mjs\");\n");'
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import http from "node:http";' 'const app=express();' 'app.use((req,res,next)=>{' ' if (!(req.path === "/api" || req.path.startsWith("/api/") || req.path.startsWith("/uploads/"))) return next();' ' const upstream=http.request({hostname:"127.0.0.1",port:4000,path:req.originalUrl,method:req.method,headers:req.headers},r=>{res.writeHead(r.statusCode,r.headers);r.pipe(res);});' ' upstream.on("error",()=>{if(!res.headersSent)res.status(502).end();else res.destroy();});' ' req.pipe(upstream);' '});' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist"));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res)=>res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'app.listen(8080,"0.0.0.0");' > server/gateway.mjs
RUN rm -rf server/uploads && ln -s /app/.data/uploads server/uploads
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=4000 DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite HOME=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/.cache
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/server ./server
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data && chown 10001:10001 /app/.data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["sh","-c","set -eu; umask 077; mkdir -p /app/.data/uploads; cd /app/server; node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --skip-generate; exec node --import tsx bootstrap.ts"]
